scope: Applicability and routing layer for the September 2026 MVP. This file is intentionally separate from the existing MVP registry until the full Rules Map is frozen.
source_hierarchy: Official Gazette amendment and commencement notification
Official DCA consolidated Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

rules.decision: The MVP applies to pre-packaged commodity inspection. If the item is not established as pre-packaged, do not silently treat it as a Chapter II retail package.
Apply the Rule 26(a) small-quantity exemption only where its conditions are satisfied.
exceptions: Pan masala exception is effective from 2026-02-01 under G.S.R. 881(E).

rules.decision: Other Rule 26 category exemptions must be represented as separate, commodity-specific branches rather than collapsed into EXEMPT_001.

Chapter II retail-package provisions apply subject to Rule 3 exclusions. Generic packages above 25 kg or 25 litre are excluded; cement, fertilizer and agricultural farm produce have the separate above-50-kg threshold; industrial/institutional packages are separately excluded.
logic: If consumer_type is industrial or institutional -> Chapter II NOT_APPLICABLE.
Else if commodity_category is cement/fertilizer/agricultural_farm_produce and package_quantity > 50 kg -> Chapter II NOT_APPLICABLE.
Else if commodity is not in that special category and package_quantity > 25 kg -> Chapter II NOT_APPLICABLE.
Else if package_quantity is expressed in litre and package_quantity > 25 L -> Chapter II NOT_APPLICABLE.
Else -> Chapter II APPLICABLE, subject to other exemptions/pathways.
rules.important_constraint: Do not apply the generic >25 kg exclusion before the special >50 kg category threshold.
manual_review_conditions: Unknown consumer type where industrial/institutional status could change applicability.
Unknown commodity category for a package near a threshold.

rules.decision: Package pathway must be established before selecting declaration rules: retail, wholesale, export, or unknown.

source.document: PCR Second? No — PCR Amendment Rules, 2025

rules.decision: For packages containing medical devices, use the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 pathway for declarations and the specified Rule 7 numeral/letter dimensions where the amendment applies.

For applicable electronic products, permitted declaration information may be provided through a QR code, but the package must inform consumers to scan the QR code for the relevant information when it is not declared on the package itself.
manual_review_conditions: QR code detected but its legal role cannot be established.
Required package instruction cannot be reliably detected.
QR-linked declaration cannot be verified by the MVP.

rules.decision: E-commerce presentation requirements must be evaluated separately from physical package declarations.
For the September 2026 baseline, use the G.S.R. 128(E) country-of-origin filter requirement for e-commerce entities selling imported products.
Replacement Rule 6(10A) wording is future-dated and must not be used for a September 2026 inspection.

source.document: DCA SOP for Determination of Net Quantity of Edible Oils & Fats
source.current_source_status: DCA-listed operational guidance; June 2026 update also identified

rules.decision: Edible oils/fats require specialized quantity determination when the SOP applies. Do not award PASS using only generic quantity logic when the specialized calculation is unsupported.
AEO Tier-2/Tier-3 bonded-warehouse declaration timing is legal context. All mandatory declarations must be present before applicable retail packages leave the warehouse.

implementation_notes: Rule 3 industrial/institutional status must not be inferred solely from package size.
Wholesale packages are a distinct Chapter III pathway; do not run retail-only Rule 6(11) unit-sale-price logic automatically on wholesale packages.
Export packages are a distinct Chapter IV pathway; packages intended for sale in India require the applicable Indian package treatment.
Medical-device status is an alternate legal pathway, not a blanket PCR exemption.
Unknown or conflicting applicability context must resolve to REVIEW, never to guessed PASS or FAIL.
This file is a reconciled applicability layer and must be merged with the main MVP registry only after the full Rules Map is frozen.
